review:
A normal-looking 10-line motorsport slot hiding a crash-style racing bonus. Three or more scatters get you in: pick a racer and chase a multiplier that keeps climbing.

How many scatters you land sets the ceiling – three allow up to 999x, four up to 2,997x and five up to 9,990x. It's the racing cousin of Always Up! x10000, and that interactive bonus makes it feel very different from regular line slots. Very high volatility, 10,490x max, 96.1% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
